Why it matters

The province publishes where hunters hunt and what they bring home, by MU (Management Unit). Read it once and you stop guessing.

Warning

Study aid only. The official regulations are the law. These are public harvest estimates, not secret spots. Every MU below has closures, private land and reserves inside it. Check the synopsis map and the access maps before you go.

Grandpa's rule (wisdom, not law)

Numbers tell you where hunters are. Your boots tell you where the deer are. Start where the numbers say, then walk a ridge farther than the trucks.

Common mistakes
  • Treating a top MU as a spot. An MU is hundreds of square kilometres. Scout a corner of it.
  • Driving a closed road because there was no sign at the gate. The closure is the law, the sign is a courtesy.
  • Chasing the best quail MU without a landowner. Most of 8-1's good cover is private.
Do this in the field

First trip in a new MU: drive the main road at dusk, glass every opening, and mark where deer feed. Hunt those edges at first light the next day, on foot.
